questionText: What is component scanning in Spring Boot?

target.learningOutcome: The learner can explain how package scanning produces bean definitions and distinguish scanning from later bean creation and other discovery mechanisms.

claims.statement: Component scanning detects classes matching component filters in configured classpath packages and registers corresponding bean definitions with the application context.
SpringBootApplication is a convenience annotation that includes component scanning in addition to Boot configuration and auto-configuration.
Component scanning is not the only bean-registration mechanism and its package settings do not configure entity or Spring Data repository scanning.
